name: hazel_weir_velocity_procedural_graph
description: Optimized Procedural Graph featuring synchronous land-labor scaling to 24 plots, strict Day-18 perennial cutoffs, contract-duration feasibility gating, in-situ field servicing pipelines, and calibrated 16-20 item batch liquidations.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, active shop contract demand, and oracle price drop signals across market commodities.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces dynamic cash reserve locks and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Fulfills active town shop contracts for 2.0x-3.5x premiums. Procures exact seed quantities for active shop demands (Carrots, Tomatoes, Pumpkins) to avoid over-commitment, while routing all uncontracted surplus to open-market sales.

nodes.name: Capital Velocity & Liquidation
nodes.description: Abolishes shed hoarding by executing continuous batch liquidations of uncontracted surplus inventory at favorable market prices, unlocking fluid cash for reinvestment and preventing idle physical stock from bottlenecking farm economy compounding.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Reads 96-step TTM forecast to dump sensitive commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) immediately before opponent market gluts collapse prices.

nodes.name: Capital Reinvestment & Yield Scaling
nodes.description: Reinvests surplus cash into workforce scaling (up to 11 hands), synchronous land expansion (20-24 plots max by Day 16), and hyper-fertilized recurring cash crops (Strawberries) for maximum multi-harvest yield compounding.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes field routines with an in-situ harvest-and-water pipeline to minimize transit waste. Prioritizes watering above shed drop-offs to eliminate growth-pausing dry intervals, maximizing plot productivity.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases; schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21; enforce emergency liquidation of non-feed, non-contract inventory at hour >= 20 to guarantee payroll.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (max(0, n_animals * 3)); never liquidate crops committed to active town shop delivery.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and (shop_deliverable_inventory > 0 or (net_available_cash >= 180.0 and active_shop_demand > 0)) and day <= 30
attributes.guidance: Allocate market slots to deliver exact matching inventory to town shops for 2.0x-3.5x premium. Only purchase seeds for active shop demands if (current_day + crop_growth_days <= contract_deadline_day). If growth duration exceeds the deadline, fulfill strictly from existing inventory or bypass the contract entirely.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not hoard inventory speculatively for future unrevealed contracts; instantly release uncontracted surplus to open-market liquidation. Do not buy shop seeds if net cash falls below 1.25x midnight payroll or if crop cannot mature before deadline.

attributes.guidance: Execute batch sales of 16-20 items of unreserved, non-shop surplus holdings when market price >= 0.82 * base_price. Maintain a firm price floor of 0.82x-0.86x base price through Day 27. Terminal Day 29-30 sweep liquidates all remaining inventory.
attributes.pitfalls: Never liquidate exact item quotas reserved for active town shop contracts. Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (max(0, n_animals * 3)). Strictly prohibit selling below 0.78x base price prior to Day 29.

attributes.guidance: Preempt lowest-margin open orders; execute rapid batch liquidations of vulnerable commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) while current market price remains favorable (> 0.75 * base_price) before opponent dumping collapses market prices.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not dump into already collapsed sub-0.50 base price markets unless shed overflow is imminent; do not front-run commodities committed to active town shop contracts.

attributes.condition: net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.5 + 100.0 and (hired_hands < 11 or uncultivated_plots > 0 or has_fertilizer_deficit) and day <= 26
attributes.guidance: Scale workforce to 11 hands. Expand contiguous land synchronously with labor: 8-10 plots at 3-4 hands, 14-16 plots at 6-7 hands, and 20-24 plots by Day 14-16 at 9-11 hands. Truncate early Carrot bootstrapping to Days 1-4. Transition 100% of newly expanded acreage to hyper-fertilized Strawberries by Days 5-8. After Day 18, ban new Strawberry planting and fertilizer procurement; pivot all post-Day-18 uncultivated plots exclusively to rapid 3-day turnaround crops (Carrots) or active town shop contracts.
attributes.pitfalls: Never expand land beyond 24 plots or after Day 16. Do not plant Strawberries or procure fertilizer after Day 18.

attributes.guidance: Formalize an in-situ field pipeline: 1) Harvest ripe plot, 2) Immediately water that exact plot in-situ before moving (zero transit cost, eliminating dry-interval pauses), 3) Harvest/water adjacent plots until worker bag capacity is reached (3-4 items), 4) Route directly to shed for deposit, 5) Pull fertilizer/seeds on shed departure only when traveling toward unserviced plots.
attributes.pitfalls: Never deprioritize watering below shed transit, as dry plots halt growth. Do not allow 1-crop transit cycles that waste worker steps. Ensure hands never idle while unharvested crops or dry plots remain.
